label: ADG 5/5 Legit Terminals (High EE3)
source: ADG updated all-class M7 POV text supplied by user
notes: Source: ADG updated all-class M7 POV text and POV clips supplied by the user. The exact written POVs are followed where role summaries conflict.
Blood camp: kill the first four mobs at about 20 seconds into camp, then camp normally. This is strategy guidance; Savepoint does not attack mobs or automate camp timing.

Maxor canonical route from the overview: Mage aggros Maxor; Tank and Healer checkpoint left/right pads (Jerry at each pad to protect spring boots); Bers is right crystal and Archer left crystal. Bers leaps to Healer and Archer to Tank after each of two crystal groups. Healer should tether Mage during prestart or after blood rush.

After crystal group two, Tank and Archer leap to Mage to finish Maxor. Healer and Bers drop to Storm; Healer reverse-predevs device 3 from behind yellow pillar; Bers digs to Storm so Mage/Tank/Archer can leap to Bers.

Source conflict: the Mage role subsection says Mage is left crystal, while the overview and other role POVs say Mage aggros and Tank/Healer checkpoint. This preset follows the overview strategy; Mage crystal-running is not seeded.

Storm: Healer does only device 3, leaps to Archer, and stands at acacia aggro spot for Mage. Tank uses spirit mask for lightning. Bers digs to chest room and predevs device 2, then clears yellow/green mobs. Archer leaps Bers, rag-swaps, deathbows mobs between red/purple, then clears purple/red mobs and stands under purple for lightning.

After lightning Mage and Tank leap to Healer. Healer runs to purple, steps on at ~29.5 for crush at 33.0, then immediately leaps Bers for SS dropoff (or digs to the lever dropoff). Tank then jumps right/up to yellow and pads it at 37.1-37.9; Mage aggros Storm from the back and hits at 40.05/41.05. Archer enrages, leaps Mage, and arrowstacks yellow at 37.5.
Healer Storm safety: tank lightning with spirit mask. Bers waits near coal/terminal entry for Healer to leap to him for SS positioning.

S1 terminal role summary: Healer SS / leap Mage for ee2; Archer 43; Bers i4 then leap Tank, then Mage when SS finishes; Tank 21 and may stack 3 for Archer melody or preleap Mage. Archer melody 2 and Bers melody targets are conditional and must be handled manually.
S2: Healer LL + ee3; Archer 4 + RL then leap Healer; Bers 5 then 3 then leap Healer; Tank starts with 1 then leaps Bers and chooses stack 3 / RL / Healer by melody; Mage continues hee2 role.
S3: Healer 2/dev then Mage if Bers beats her to device; Archer 4 and preleaps S4 if Tank already left for levers; Bers 3/dev then Mage; Tank 1 then Archer for split levers and Mage for core.
S4: Archer and Bers leap Mage to enter, then after term leap Mage again; Bers also leaps Mage after levers. Tank 1 then Mage. Healer 4BL then Mage. Mage holds core/recore.

After Goldor, dig into the far wall for instamid Necron. P4 Necron/relic route: Mage leaps Healer after drop; Archer, Bers and Tank leap Healer at 70m. Healer moves between blue/purple, then runs purple and leaps Bers after the pickup; Archer takes red, Bers orange, Tank green (leaps Archer), Mage blue (leaps Bers).

Melody branches are intentionally described but not baked into fixed targets: Savepoint cannot detect melody, boss timers, device completion, mob spawns, gear swaps, mask pops, pad movement, or player movement.
The earlier Mage POV listed Mage crystal runner; this preset follows the overview Maxor strategy and not that alternate/contradictory line.

P1.1.label: crystal group 1
P1.1.desc: Bers is right crystal to Healer on right pad; Archer is left crystal to Tank on left pad.

P1.2.label: crystal group 2
P1.2.desc: Grab the second set and repeat the same checkpoints: Bers -> Healer, Archer -> Tank.

P1.3.label: finish Maxor
P1.3.desc: After crystals, Tank and Archer leap Mage to finish Maxor. Healer and Bers drop to Storm.

P2.GY.1.label: Storm entry / Bers checkpoint
P2.GY.1.desc: Healer reverse-predevs device 3; Bers digs to Storm. Mage, Tank and Archer leap Bers.

P2.GY.2.label: Healer acacia checkpoint
P2.GY.2.desc: After device 3, Healer leaps Archer and stands at acacia aggro spot for Mage.

P2.GY.3.label: lightning / Tank and Mage to Healer
P2.GY.3.desc: Tank wears spirit mask for lightning. After Mage leaps to Healer, Tank also leaps to Healer then moves right/up to yellow.

P2.GY.4.label: purple crush / Healer to Bers
P2.GY.4.desc: Healer steps on purple at ~29.5 for crush at 33.0, then leaps Bers for SS dropoff (or digs to lever dropoff).

P2.GY.5.label: yellow crush / enrage
P2.GY.5.desc: Tank pads yellow at 37.1-37.9; Mage hits Storm at 40.05/41.05. Archer leaps Mage and arrowstacks yellow at 37.5.

P3.S1.ENTRY.1.label: S1 entry / SS setup
P3.S1.ENTRY.1.desc: When Storm ends, Archer and Tank leap Healer. Healer does SS before her Mage leap.

P3.S1.1.label: after i4 / melody branch
P3.S1.1.desc: After SS, Healer leaps Mage for ee2. Bers leaps Tank after i4. Tank may stack for Archer melody; Archer may leap Tank for melody 2.

P3.S1.2.label: after SS / preleap Mage
P3.S1.2.desc: Bers leaps Mage when SS finishes. Archer leaps Mage when section finishes unless melody stack is needed. Tank preleaps Mage when no stack is needed.

P3.S2.1.label: S2 entry
P3.S2.1.desc: Tank completes 1 then leaps Bers. Other roles do their S2 terminals and levers.

P3.S2.2.label: S2 to Healer ee3
P3.S2.2.desc: Archer after 4/RL, Bers after 5/3, and Tank after melody choices leap Healer at ee3.

P3.S3.1.label: S3 terminals / levers split
P3.S3.1.desc: Healer/Bers/Archer leap Mage after their device/terminal timing. Tank completes 1 then leaps Archer to split levers.

P3.S3.2.label: after split levers
P3.S3.2.desc: Tank leaps Mage for core. Healer may also leap Mage if Bers completes device first.

P3.S4.1.label: S4 entry
P3.S4.1.desc: Archer and Bers leap Mage to enter S4.

P3.S4.2.label: after S4 terminal
P3.S4.2.desc: Archer and Bers leap Mage after their terminal; Tank leaps Mage after 1.

P3.S4.3.label: after S4 levers / recore
P3.S4.3.desc: Bers leaps Mage again after levers; Healer leaps Mage after 4BL.

P4.1.label: Necron drop
P4.1.desc: Mage leaps Healer after Necron drops them.

P4.2.label: 70m / Necron death handoff
P4.2.desc: At 70m Archer and Bers leap Healer; Tank leaps Healer after Necron dies.

P4.3.label: relic handoffs
P4.3.desc: Healer/Mage leap Bers for purple/blue; Tank leaps Archer for green. Archer takes red; Bers orange.
